change-colour-option-on-the-present.text: If no other colours are unlocked:

steps.text: Deliver the present to the residents of Gielinor to unlock more colours. Check the name tag!

change-colour-option-on-the-present.text: If at least one colour is unlocked:

options.text: I want to unlock more colours!
options.condition: If at least one colour still locked:

steps.text: Deliver the present to the residents of Gielinor to unlock more colours. Check the name tag!

unlocking-blue-read-tag.text: I sell tools that chop. Near where adventures begin. Come visit my shop.

options.text: I have a present for you!

steps.player: I have a present for you!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Lovely! I've been waiting for you to turn up!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Yes! Didn't anybody tell you? This present is actually for you!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: All for you. Every time you deliver it, you'll unlock a new colour of wrapping paper for it.

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: It's a pretty magical present!

steps.player: That sounds pretty cool! So I can change its colour?

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Yep. Look, you can change its wrapping paper to blue now.
Bob performs an enchant animation and unlocks the new colour.
You've unlocked blue wrapping paper for your present.

steps.player: That's so cool! Who do I deliver it to next?

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: You'll have to figure that out for yourself, that's the fun. Check the name tag!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: I'm going to get back to work, good luck.

unlocking-green-read-tag.text: Red, yellow and blue. Onion, woad, redberries. All will do. Witch one will you choose?

options.text: I have a present for you!

steps.player: I have a present for you!

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Hello [player name]. You've found me, well done.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Let me unlock the next colour for you.
Aggie performs an enchant animation and unlocks the new colour.
You've unlocked green wrapping paper for your present.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Good luck with the next one!

unlocking-black-read-tag.text: I sell news each day. 'Read all about it' I say. A low price to pay.

options.text: I have a present for you!

steps.player: I have a present for you!

steps.speaker: Benny
steps.text: Hi [player name]. I didn't think you'd find me!

steps.speaker: Benny
steps.text: I suppose I should have made the clue harder.

steps.speaker: Benny
steps.text: I'll unlock the next colour for you.
Benny performs an enchant animation and unlocks the new colour.
You've unlocked black wrapping paper for your present.

steps.speaker: Benny
steps.text: It's no problem. Good luck with the last one!

unlocking-gold-read-tag.text: I summon the dead. Skeletons, Zombies and Ghosts. Land, Flame, Wind and Sea.

options.text: I have a present for you!

steps.player: I have a present for you!

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: I see. Let's do this quickly, I am quite busy.
Malignius Mortifer performs an enchant animation and unlocks the new colour.
You've unlocked gold wrapping paper for your present.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: You've completed your tasks, well done.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Yes. Always save the best until last.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Obviously, I am Malignius Mortifer.

steps.player: Ah yes, the great Malignius Mortifer...

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: You don't think I'm great?

steps.player: I do! Of course I do.

steps.speaker: Malignius Mortifer
steps.text: Good, now begone.

read-tag-after-unlocking-all-colours.text: You've already delivered the present to everyone and unlocked all the colours of wrapping paper.
